home.statisticsSubtitle: Sample values shown for interface preview.

compliance.title: Legal Metrology
compliance.description: Check mandatory declarations and identify potential non-compliance.
compliance.footnote: Automated assessment. Manual verification recommended before any enforcement action.

scan.title: Scan Product
scan.subtitle: Position the product label inside the frame.
scan.placeholderHint: The live label preview will appear here.
scan.footnote: Checks are based only on information visible on the label. A camera cannot measure the quantity sealed inside a package.
scan.chooseSampleHint: No usable camera? Pick a sample label instead. Each one is sent to the real backend.
scan.permissionHint: LabelGuard uses the camera to photograph the product label it checks.
scan.permissionDeniedHint: Camera access is turned off. Enable it in your device settings, then return here.
scan.captureFailed: The photo could not be captured. Please try again.

processing.title: Analysing Label
processing.subtitle: Running the label through the compliance pipeline.
processing.completeDescription: Automated assessment complete. Manual verification recommended.
processing.loadingSubtitle: Sending the label to the compliance pipeline. This usually takes a moment.
processing.loadingSubtitleImage: Uploading the photo, reading the label text, then running the compliance checks.

result.title: Result
result.legalNotice: Automated assessment. Manual verification is recommended before any enforcement action.
result.verificationDescription: How the declared claim compares with what was observed.

verification.matchHelper: The observed value matches the declared claim.
verification.mismatchHelper: The observed value differs from the declared claim. Manual verification is recommended.
verification.reviewHelper: This result needs a manual check before any conclusion.
verification.couldNotHelper: This claim could not be reliably verified from the available evidence.
verification.notApplicableHelper: There was nothing to verify for this item.
verification.title: What was verified?
verification.subtitle: Label-to-product verification
verification.emptyDescription: This inspection has no label-to-product checks.
verification.explanation: Each check compares the claim printed on the label (declared) with what was observed.
verification.massNotice: Weight and volume come from a manual measurement — a phone camera cannot weigh a product.

evidence.title: Evidence Preview
evidence.subtitle: Automated assessment with sample evidence.
evidence.manualMessage: This is an automated assessment. Manual verification is recommended before any enforcement action.
evidence.newPhotoNote: Photo capture is not enabled in this preview build; a sample item was added.
evidence.newUploadNote: Image upload is not enabled in this preview build; a sample item was added.
evidence.emptyDescription: Use the actions above to add a photo, a measurement or a note.
evidence.advisory: Evidence supports manual verification. It is not by itself a legal determination.
evidence.regionCaption: The highlighted region marks where this was found on the label.
evidence.placeholderNotice: This is a sample item created for the preview. A real capture or upload will replace it.
evidence.detailAdvisory: Evidence supports manual verification. It is not by itself a legal determination.

history.title: Inspection History
history.subtitle: Sample records for interface preview.

live.legalUnavailable: The legal label check could not be completed for this scan, so it is marked for manual review — not as compliant.
live.apiNote: Real result from the backend, based only on information visible on the label.
live.errorNetwork: Could not reach the server. Check that the backend is running and try again.

live.errorMalformed: The server response could not be read. Please try again.
